evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A conceptual distinction asserted as self-evident logic, performing rational-persuasion by framing a category boundary the reader is expected to accept on the force of the contrast alone.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Supplies a reframe that controls which facts matter — the substrate is devalued, the perspective is elevated — performing informational control through the selective framing itself, with rational-persuasion in the asserted logic of asset-vs-commodity.

mints.name: AssetReframeViaContrast
mints.title: the perspective is the asset you keep
mints.frame: Is the speaker establishing what is valuable by reclassifying one term as commodity and another as asset, rather than by argument from evidence?
